notes.title: Aura Skills hotfix
notes.notes:
Aura slash and Aura slash combo shoot out their attacks again and received a slight buff.
Energy wave has been slightly nerfed.

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes: Small things such as, particle transparency, movement towards your targets when attacking, camera issues and more have had tweaks.

notes.title: MAJOR COMBAT UPDATE + INVENTORY
notes.notes:
New Directional Attack combos
Lunge punch forward north face button
Short uppercut backwards north face button
Rapid stabbing forward west face button
Heavy slam attack backward west face button
New Hold hits
You can hold the north face button or the west face button for two additional ways to attack
New delay attack combo on the north face button if you wait half a second before pressing it again
New inventory system for saving and swapping between passives you buy while playing through the game.
You can also store and stack multiple of each type.
Dodging has been smoothed and given Iframes.
Controls for dodging have been made more clear.
Camera has been given a slight delay before updating its position.

notes.title: Minor update vibration control feedback
notes.notes:
Control now vibrates in combat
Minor camera adjustments
Fixed animations getting stuck when locking off

notes.title: Mouse and keyboard controls! + Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Minor camera adjustments
Camera shakes and post process effects should work more consistent now.
Hit stops have been removed
Menus are a lil more easier to navigate.
Key board and mouse controls have been implemented

notes.title: Version 0.1.2 Polish step update
notes.notes:
Camera logic has all been updated and works as its supposed to.
Lock-on management has been redone as well.
Dodges have been made longer and work more efficiently.
Gravity and jump force has been adjusted.
Camera distancing has been adjusted.

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 Hotfix #1 Saving system has been implemented
notes.notes: The game auto saves when you buy skills and complete levels!
